Once upon a time, there was a big, strong ant named Andy. Andy had a job to carry heavy things from one place to another. He had to carry big things. One day, he saw a big hill. The hill was very tall and Andy wanted to go up.
Andy tried to carry the big thing with his strong legs. But the big thing was too heavy. He tried and tried, but the big thing was still too heavy. Andy felt sad. He wanted to go up the big thing so badly.
Just then, a kind bird named Betty saw Andy. She knew that it was okay to carry big things. Betty told Andy that the big thing was not enough. Andy felt better and carried the big thing together. Together, they went up the hill and finally reached the top. Andy and Betty were so happy that they could go up the big thing. They learned that even when things are hard, they can be used to help them.
